name: Aptos Village
summary: Aptos Village is a charming 11.5-acre lifestyle center in Aptos featuring a pedestrian-friendly town square with quaint shops, diverse restaurants, and a historic apple barn grocer. This mixed-use development combines traditional architecture with modern amenities, creating a vibrant community atmosphere between the trees and ocean.
demographics: Aptos Village attracts affluent families and professionals from the greater Santa Cruz County area, with visitors typically in the 35-65 age range and above-average household incomes. The trade area draws from the upscale coastal communities of Aptos, Capitola, and surrounding beach towns, appealing to educated homeowners seeking a pedestrian-friendly shopping experience. The center caters to quality-conscious consumers who value local businesses, specialty retail, and community-oriented amenities in a charming village atmosphere.
description: Aptos Village is a distinctive lifestyle center that captures the essence of small-town charm while delivering modern luxury and convenience. Thoughtfully planned across 11.5 spacious acres in the heart of Aptos, this traditional, pedestrian-friendly town square features timeless architecture nestled between trees and the ocean. The center includes a historic apple barn that now houses a local neighborhood grocer, along with quaint shops and a variety of restaurants for any occasion. Beyond its commercial offerings, Aptos Village encompasses a residential component with 69 new homes ranging from 2-4 bedrooms and townhouse options, creating a true live-work-play environment. This vibrant mixed-use community combines the leisurely pace of days gone by with all the energy efficiency and amenities expected by today's modern families, making it a unique destination on California's central coast.
